method: Two independent ENet processes. Headless source uses the ordinary War server shot validator and reliable remote_shot_packet. Native observer waits for343m/s propagation and captures PCM from WeaponShots using unmodified Glock/FAL/sniper WAVs. A small flat acoustic arena and diagnostic all-three-weapon inventory isolate sound; full-map combat, human listening is not asserted; native propagation timing is covered by ballistics171.
